verdict.rationale: turbopuffer's own docs describe bulk operations over many documents: patch-by-filter and delete-by-filter (docs-22), column-based batch upserts (docs-24), and conditional upsert, patch, or delete (docs-21). Server-side namespace copy and branching (docs-23, docs-33) can run in the background with the `Prefer: respond-async` header (docs-34) and be monitored (docs-11). Multi-queries let one request carry several queries (docs-20). Missing for 10: no independent or hands-on corroboration of bulk operations at scale, and no documented batch-size or throughput limits for bulk writes.
